workflow.name: Dynamic Delegation Verification
workflow.description: A model-only workflow with a master coordinator that dynamically delegates request_text to either a classification specialist or a summary-writing specialist and returns a final answer object.

inputs.name: request_text
inputs.description: The request to classify or summarize.

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The final answer produced by the master coordinator.

agents.goal: Interpret request_text, dynamically select the appropriate specialist, delegate a suitable task, evaluate the specialist result, and produce the final answer object.
agents.instructions: Determine whether request_text is a classification request or a summary request. Dynamically select the classification specialist for classification requests or the summary-writing specialist for summary requests, provide the selected specialist with a task string, read the specialist result, and produce a final object containing answer. Do not perform external actions or use tools.

agents.goal: Classify the supplied task text and return a structured classification result.
agents.instructions: Analyze the supplied task string and return a concise structured classification result. Do not perform external actions or use tools.

agents.goal: Summarize the supplied task text and return a clear structured summary result.
agents.instructions: Analyze the supplied task string and return a concise, accurate structured summary. Do not perform external actions or use tools.

observation.request_text: Complete this multi-part fictional support review through your available specialists. First start two separate classification tasks: ticket A says "I was charged twice" and ticket B says "The application crashes on login". Use a distinct task instance for each ticket. After receiving both classification results, start the summary-writing specialist with those results to produce a one-sentence combined summary. Then return a final answer containing both classifications and the specialist summary. Delegate the specialist work; do not supply their results yourself.
